name: distributed-compute-playground
description: A static, gamified drag-and-drop playground for learning how Apache Spark jobs are planned and executed: build a job layer by layer, read the plan it would produce, and solve exam-style case studies.
author: AnikethSD <anikethsdeshpande@gmail.com>

scripts.check: node --check src/data/components.js && node --check src/data/workloads.js && node --check src/data/missions.js && node --check src/core/engine.js && node --check src/ui/app.js
scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:ui
